title: FAQ — Kaki Bakery
text:

Questions

Q: Do you have eggless cakes?
A: Yes, the butter cake and pandan chiffon come eggless. Order 3 days ahead.

Q: Are your cakes halal?
A: Our kitchen is not halal-certified, but we use no pork or lard.

Q: Can I collect on Sundays?
A: Yes, collection is from 9 am to 1 pm on Sundays.
